lines.text: Jesus goes home and a crowd gathers, and His family goes out to take custody of Him.
The scribes who came down from Jerusalem say Jesus is possessed by Beelzebul and drives out demons by the prince of the demons.
Jesus says a divided kingdom or house cannot stand, and no one can plunder a strong man's house unless he first ties up the strong man.
Jesus says whoever blasphemes against the angels will never be forgiven, because they were saying He has an unclean spirit.
When His mother and brothers wait outside, Jesus says whoever is born into His family is His brother and sister and mother.
